Class TurIntegrationMonitoringToolService

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.genai.tool.TurIntegrationMonitoringToolService
@Service public class TurIntegrationMonitoringToolService extends Object
Tool calling service for integration monitoring and indexing analysis via LLM. Provides tools to query connector indexing status, statistics, and content tracking, enabling the LLM to cross-reference with logging tools for root cause analysis.
Since:
2026.1.17
Author:
Alexandre Oliveira
